correctness.rationale: A_n=tr(T^n) by a bijection between cyclic rung words and length-n closed walks in the explicit 16-state transfer. An exact integer Faddeev-LeVerrier calculation and Cayley-Hamilton replay reproduce six factored characteristic factors; their explicit golden-ratio roots give all six residue formulas for every n>=3. Independent brute-force enumeration for n=3..9 and trace checks for n=3..30 agree. Colour swap is fixed-point-free. No finite-only inference is used.

evidence: 2026 planar theorem: every planar graph of minimum degree >=3 admits at least one two-total-domatic colouring; no count is given (https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1002/jgt.70032).

2025 enumerative paper specifically asks for general formulas for N(G x P2) and treats the 5-prism only as an order-ten 3-regular graph with d_t=2 (https://www.researchgate.net/publication/397926836_Enumeration_of_total_domatic_partitions).
broader_coverage.reasoning: The existence guarantee A_n>0 is strictly weaker than its exact all-n value, and one example n=5 and structural results on open ladders do not imply the six-parameter cyclic formula. N(G), meaning maximum-size partitions, must be distinguished from the exact number of 2-class partitions computed here.

value.rationale: Asadzadeh-Alikhani explicitly pose exact enumeration of total-domatic partitions under Cartesian products and discuss prisms. The formula determines a natural entire infinite family of two-class partition counts, previously only existentially guaranteed by the planar 2-TDC theorem, and identifies a non-obvious six-periodic Lucas correction; the exact invariant is motivated before computation and useful for comparing local-colouring counts on structured cubic graphs. It does not overclaim maximum-class counts or arbitrary product graphs.
